blurb: Arise Yoga offers a variety of yoga experiences including restorative yoga combined with face yoga and sound baths, family yoga classes for kids and adults, and workshops focused on mindfulness and intention. Sessions include guided self-massage, Gua sha, and yoga for the face, as well as playful movement and partner poses for families. Classes are designed for all levels, with no experience needed.
